Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is a comparative analysis of the salivary proteome across different mammalian species to identify lineage-specific mucins. It is not a perturbation study (no drug, genetic knockout, or environmental stressor was applied); rather, it is a cross-species anatomical/biological comparison. Therefore, it is mapped to anatomical_spatial as the primary variable is the species-specific origin of the saliva samples. No specific child class for 'species comparison' exists in the provided ontology, so only the parent class is used.
